title: deps-report
summary: Produces a third-party dependency rollup from an index: which external units/libraries an indexed codebase depends on
intro: Read this when you are auditing which external units or libraries a codebase depends on. deps-report rolls up the third-party dependencies from one or more indexes, as text, json or csv.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint deps-report --db <file.sqlite> [--db ...] [--depth N] [--edges] [--all-sources] [--name <pat>] [--format text|json|csv] [--output <file>] (third-party dependency rollup)
help: drag-lint deps-report --db <file.sqlite> [--db ...] [--depth N] [--edges] [--all-sources] [--name <pat>] [--format text|json|csv] [--output|--out <file>]   (third-party dependency rollup)

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Uses & Dependencies > Dependency Report (third-party rollup)...
steps: Choose drag-lint > Uses & Dependencies > Dependency Report (third-party rollup)...
Read the rollup of external units and libraries

questions.ask: Which third-party units and libraries does my codebase depend on?
Can I export the dependency rollup as CSV?
